entities.description: Procedure executed by UE to release SCG configuration, including resetting MAC, releasing RLC bearers and BH RLC channels, and stopping various timers.

entities.name: SCG MAC
entities.description: MAC entity associated with the Secondary Cell Group.

entities.name: RLC Bearer Release Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for releasing RLC bearers as specified in clause 5.3.5.5.3.

entities.name: BH RLC Channel Release Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for releasing BH RLC channels as specified in clause 5.3.5.5.10.

entities.name: SCG Configuration
entities.description: Configuration parameters for the Secondary Cell Group.

entities.name: Conditional PSCell Change Configured
entities.description: Condition indicating whether Conditional PSCell Change (CPC) was configured.

entities.name: Timer T310
entities.description: Timer associated with the corresponding SpCell.

entities.name: Timer T312
entities.description: Timer associated with the corresponding SpCell.

entities.name: Timer T304
entities.description: Timer associated with the corresponding SpCell.

entities.name: SpCell
entities.description: Special Cell associated with the SCG.

relations.description: SCG release procedure resets SCG MAC if configured.
SCG release procedure includes performing RLC bearer release for each RLC bearer in SCG configuration.
SCG release procedure includes performing BH RLC channel release for each BH RLC channel in SCG configuration.
SCG release procedure releases the SCG configuration.
If CPC was configured, SCG release procedure removes all entries in VarConditionalReconfig.
SCG release procedure stops timer T310 for the corresponding SpCell if running.
SCG release procedure stops timer T312 for the corresponding SpCell if running.
SCG release procedure stops timer T304 for the corresponding SpCell if running.
